description: The responsible-gambling core of the Eclipse betting suite: a limits engine with the industry's asymmetry law built in (decreases apply immediately; increases wait out the stricter of a suite cooling floor or the state's delay, then need a fresh confirmation or they lapse — and no tool path exists that raises a limit), absolute self-exclusion honored identically from any source with no early-end tool, a versioned state jurisdiction matrix whose staleness degrades verdicts to UNKNOWN-and-deny, a unified ledger of the user's own bet records with honest cash P&L (bonus bets are not cash: stake never returned, unsettled bonus valued at zero), pattern flags computed on ledger data only and surfaced as facts, and fixture odds comparison ordered by price only with operator promotions stripped. Not a sportsbook: there is no placement tool, no account connection, and no credential is accepted anywhere — records enter only from the user's own exports and entries. B0 runs on fixtures and synthetic records; live users wait on the spec's counsel gate.
